title: GAIA Controller ↔ Prithvi Interface
description: Defines the Request and Response data contract between the GAIA Agentic Controller and the Prithvi-based perception layer.

PrithviRequest.description: Request sent from the Controller to the Prithvi perception layer.

images.description: One or more image references to be processed.

parameters.description: Optional parameters or configuration for the Prithvi task.

pair_info.description: Optional information identifying a temporal pair or cross-modal pair (e.g., pre/post, optical/SAR).

PrithviResponse.description: Response returned from Prithvi to the Controller.

status.description: Execution status indicating whether the Prithvi call succeeded or failed.

results.description: Structured perception results (e.g., bounding boxes, statistics, class distributions).

evidence.description: Evidence references such as segmentation masks or change maps.

metrics.description: Optional numeric scores or metrics (e.g., confidence scores, IoU, change percentage).

errors.description: List of errors if the call failed.

warnings.description: List of warnings generated during execution.

PrithviImage.description: Reference to an image payload, potentially with modality information.

uri.description: Path or URI to the image data.

EvidenceItem.description: A piece of visual or structured evidence (like a segmentation mask reference).

data.description: The structure payload containing mask URIs, bounding box coords, etc.
